items.imgPrompt: a cream-coloured metal stand mixer sitting on a clean wooden kitchen counter, slightly used but well-maintained, warm natural light, cozy domestic setting

desc.zh: 之前用來給小乖做甜點的。最近她迷上了工序繁瑣的千層蛋糕，原來的容量有些不夠，便為她換了台大的。機器保養得很好，希望能為您的家人帶去甜蜜。
desc.zh_cn: 之前用来给小乖做甜点的。最近她迷上了工序繁琐的千层蛋糕，原来的容量有些不够，便为她换了台大的。机器保养得很好，希望能为您的家人带去甜蜜。
desc.en: Used to make desserts for Xiaoguai. She recently fell in love with complex mille-crepe cakes, and this capacity was a bit too small, so I bought a larger one. Well-maintained, hope it brings sweetness to your family.

items.imgPrompt: a neatly folded thick white pure wool blanket resting on a simple chair, soft textures, natural lighting, pristine condition, cozy room background

name.en: Extra Thick Pure Wool Woven Blanket

desc.zh: 入冬前特意為她添置的，但妹妹嫌它壓在身上太重，總說不如……不如靠在我懷裡暖和。幾乎全新，已經仔細清洗熨燙過了，不會有任何過敏原。
desc.zh_cn: 入冬前特意为她添置的，但妹妹嫌它压在身上太重，总说不如……不如靠在我怀里暖和。几乎全新，已经仔细清洗熨烫过了，不会有任何过敏原。
desc.en: Bought it for her before winter, but my sister complained it was too heavy, saying it wasn't as warm as... resting in my arms. Practically new, already carefully dry-cleaned and pressed, free of allergens.

items.imgPrompt: an elegant dark glass cologne bottle inside its pristine cardboard packaging box, sitting on a dark wooden table, unopened, soft indoor lighting

desc.zh: 外區主教來訪時贈予的禮物。我平時不染香水，也怕這氣味會蓋住小乖身上的味道，更怕熏著她。未曾拆封，價格隨意，若您有需要便拍下吧。
desc.zh_cn: 外区主教来访时赠予的礼物。我平时不染香水，也怕这气味会盖住小乖身上的味道，更怕熏着她。未曾拆封，价格随意，若您有需要便拍下吧。
desc.en: A gift from a visiting bishop. I don't wear perfume, and I'm afraid the scent might mask Xiaoguai's scent, or make her sneeze. Unopened, price is highly negotiable, take it if you need it.

items.imgPrompt: an ornate vintage brass candelabra with three arms, slight tarnish on the base, sitting on a plain linen tablecloth, warm ambient lighting

desc.zh: 造型很精緻，但底座邊緣有一處略微銳利。我不希望它擺在餐桌上時，不小心劃傷伸手拿糖果的妹妹。降價處理，適合放在高處做裝飾。
desc.zh_cn: 造型很精致，但底座边缘有一处略微锐利。我不希望它摆在餐桌上时，不小心划伤伸手拿糖果的妹妹。降价处理，适合放在高处做装饰。
desc.en: The design is exquisite, but one edge of the base is slightly sharp. I don't want it on the dining table in case it scratches my sister when she reaches for candies. Discounted, best used as high-shelf decor.

items.imgPrompt: a thick black hardcover book with faded gold lettering, resting on a wooden desk next to a silver cross, slightly worn corners, soft study room lighting

desc.zh: 書房裡有兩本一樣的，這本是多餘的。內頁整潔無筆記，願神指引你的求知之路。（註：晚上九點後請勿留言，我要哄妹妹睡覺了，失禮之處還望海涵。）
desc.zh_cn: 书房里有两本一样的，这本是多余的。内页整洁无笔记，愿神指引你的求知之路。（注：晚上九点后请勿留言，我要哄妹妹睡觉了，失礼之处还望海涵。）
desc.en: I have two identical copies in the study, this one is extra. Pages are clean with no notes. May God guide your studies. (Note: Please do not message after 9 PM, I need to coax my sister to sleep. Forgive my lack of manners.)
